import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Solution {

    static Integer[][][] memo;

    public static int compute(int position, int digit, int lastTwo, int length, String s) {
        if (position == length) {
            if (lastTwo == 0 || lastTwo == 25 || lastTwo == 50 || lastTwo == 75) {
                return 1;
            }
            return 0;
        }
        if (memo[position][digit][lastTwo] != null) {
            return memo[position][digit][lastTwo];
        }
        int total = 0;
        char currentChar = s.charAt(position);
        if (currentChar == 'X') {
            if (digit != 10) {
                total = compute(position + 1, digit, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + digit, length, s);
            } else {
                for (int i = (position == 0 ? 1 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
                    total += compute(position + 1, i, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + i, length, s);
                }
            }
        } else if (currentChar == '_') {
            for (int i = (position == 0 ? 1 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
                total += compute(position + 1, i, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + i, length, s);
            }
        } else {
            total += compute(position + 1, digit, (lastTwo % 10) * 10 + (currentChar - '0'), length, s);
        }
        return memo[position][digit][lastTwo] = total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String inputStr = scanner.next();
        int n = inputStr.length();
        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(inputStr.charAt(0) == '0' ? 1 : 0);
        } else if (inputStr.charAt(0) == '0') {
            System.out.println(0);
        } else {
            memo = new Integer[n][11][100];
            System.out.println(compute(0, 10, 0, n, inputStr));
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
